---
title: "Unrestricted overall survival — Adjusted (hierarchical) imputation"
format: html
---

- Sensitivity analysis: diagnosis as cluster (`2l.pmm`) instead of the lung indicator.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(mice)
library(miceadds) # provides mice.impute.2l.pmm
library(knitr)
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "covariates.R"))

results_dir <- here(
  "analysis", "02-overall-survival", "05-unrestricted-hierarchical", "results"
)
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

imputation_path <- file.path(results_dir, "imputation.rds")
indices <- seq_len(config$imputation$m_supporting)
```

## Imputation data

```{r}
#| label: prepare-imputation-data
#| include: false

prepared <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet")
) |>
  # Column order sets the MICE visit sequence.
  select(
    id,
    tx,
    survival_time_days_unrestricted,
    status_death_unrestricted,
    diagnosis,
    ecog_fstcnt,
    stage_binary,
    age,
    gender,
    albumin,
    bilirubin,
    c_reactive_protein,
    lactate_dehydrogenase
  ) |>
  mutate(
    diagnosis = factor(diagnosis),
    diagnosis_id = as.integer(diagnosis),
    gender = factor(gender)
  )

stopifnot(
  !anyNA(prepared$diagnosis),
  !anyDuplicated(prepared$id),
  all(prepared$survival_time_days_unrestricted >= 0)
)

prepared <- prepared |>
  mutate(
    na_est = nelsonaalen(
      pick(everything()),
      timevar = survival_time_days_unrestricted,
      statusvar = status_death_unrestricted
    )
  )

imputation_data <- prepared |>
  select(-diagnosis)
```

## Imputation model

```{r}
#| label: impute
#| include: false

incomplete <- names(which(colSums(is.na(imputation_data)) > 0))

methods <- make.method(imputation_data)
methods[] <- ""
methods[incomplete] <- "2l.pmm"

predictors <- make.predictorMatrix(imputation_data)
predictors[, c("id", "survival_time_days_unrestricted")] <- 0
predictors[!nzchar(methods), ] <- 0
predictors[incomplete, "diagnosis_id"] <- -2

if (!file.exists(imputation_path)) {
  imputation <- mice(
    imputation_data,
    method = methods,
    predictorMatrix = predictors,
    m = config$imputation$m_supporting,
    maxit = config$imputation$maxit,
    donors = config$imputation$donors,
    seed = 4101L,
    printFlag = FALSE
  )

  saveRDS(imputation, imputation_path, compress = "xz")
}

imputation <- readRDS(imputation_path)
```

## Completed datasets

```{r}
#| label: complete
#| include: false

completed_datasets <- map(indices, \(index) {
  completed <- complete(imputation, index) |>
    mutate(
      diagnosis = prepared$diagnosis,
      ecog_binary = derive_ecog_binary(ecog_fstcnt),
      mgps = factor(derive_mgps(albumin, c_reactive_protein), levels = 0:2)
    )

  stopifnot(
    !anyNA(completed),
    all(completed$ecog_fstcnt %in% 0:4),
    imputation$m == config$imputation$m_supporting,
    identical(
      completed$survival_time_days_unrestricted,
      prepared$survival_time_days_unrestricted
    ),
    identical(
      completed$status_death_unrestricted,
      prepared$status_death_unrestricted
    ),
    all(imputation$predictorMatrix[incomplete, "diagnosis_id"] == -2),
    # Binary ECOG and mGPS agree with the completed source values.
    identical(
      completed$ecog_binary,
      derive_ecog_binary(completed$ecog_fstcnt)
    ),
    identical(
      as.integer(as.character(completed$mgps)),
      derive_mgps(completed$albumin, completed$c_reactive_protein)
    )
  )

  completed
})

saveRDS(completed_datasets, file.path(results_dir, "completed-datasets.rds"))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-os-hierarchical-imputation-traces

plot_mice_traces(mice_chain_stats(imputation))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-os-hierarchical-imputation-distributions

#| echo: false

lab_values <- imputed_values(
  imputation,
  c(
    Albumin = "albumin",
    Bilirubin = "bilirubin",
    CRP = "c_reactive_protein",
    LDH = "lactate_dehydrogenase"
  )
)

plot_imputed_densities(lab_values$observed, lab_values$imputed)
```
